data_fields.name: boon_amount_per_item
data_fields.donor_constant: static_item_boons.amount per item base and shrine type (rows not in src)

data_fields.name: boon_strength_base
data_fields.donor_constant: 40 at rank 0 (trains = 40 - rank x 10, floor 0; unit not read)

best_idea: A shrine is a city-owned place with a favour pool that members fill by offering boon items, ranked by pool size so the top shrines decay daily and the rank sets a claimed power's strength, and each claim spends one favour.
decision_why: Keep the offering-to-pool rule, the one-favour rank-scaled claim and the daily top-rank decay as shrine zone rows and one favour ledger row; reject the guild-owned city and the stack-item loot; fix the unguarded debit and the truncating decay.
acceptance: An item with a boon amount of 10 and count 2 adds 20 favour to a shrine of its type and leaves the bag; a rank-0 claim gives strength 40, rank 1 gives 30, rank 2 gives 20; a claim on an empty shrine is refused with the favour unchanged; a pool of 1 decays to 1, not 0.
